description: This file defines the Settings class in Drupal core, responsible for managing read-only site settings, handling deprecations, singleton pattern, and initialization logic.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A final class providing read-only access to site settings with singleton pattern, deprecation handling, and initialization methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Settings object with provided settings array and sets the singleton instance.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of Settings, throws exception if not initialized.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Prevents cloning of the singleton instance.

methods.name: __sleep
methods.description: Prevents serialization of the Settings object by throwing an exception.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a setting value by name, triggers deprecation warning if deprecated.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all stored settings, mainly for testing.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Bootstraps settings from settings.php, initializes database connections, and creates singleton instance.

methods.name: getHashSalt
methods.description: Returns a salt for security purposes, throws exception if missing.

methods.name: getApcuPrefix
methods.description: Generates a cache key prefix for APCu, based on site configuration.

methods.name: handleDeprecations
methods.description: Handles deprecated settings, triggers warnings, and maintains backward compatibility.
